lore: Not a riot. A suggestion.

name: Tin Vest
effect: Give a friendly character Shielding.
lore: It will stop the first one. That is the point.

name: Smoke Step
effect: Give a friendly character Stealth.
lore: Walk out in the cloud. Do not look back.

name: Loose Egg
effect: Summon a 2/1 Raptor.
lore: It was in the briefcase. It is not now.

name: Long Read
effect: Draw 2 cards.
lore: Too many pages. One of them matters.

name: Parking Garage
effect: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
lore: Level C. No cameras. One echo.

name: Clinic Cot
effect: At the start of your turn, restore 1 Health to your hero.
lore: The nurse does not ask names.

name: Filing Cage
effect: At the start of your turn, if you have fewer cards than your opponent, draw a card.
lore: Lost files find the person who needs them least.

name: Night Shift
effect: At the start of your turn, heal 1 damage from all your characters.
lore: The building hums. The bruises fade.

name: Empty Lot
effect: At the start of your turn, restore 1 Health to your hero.
lore: Weeds, glass, and a deal.

name: Black Site Annex
effect: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
lore: Off the books. Still on the map.

name: Hourly Motel
effect: At the start of your turn, restore 1 Health to your hero.
lore: The ice machine works. The locks do not.

name: Pier Shed
effect: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
lore: Salt, rust, and a light that never turns off.

name: Back Clinic
effect: At the start of your turn, heal 1 damage from all your characters.
lore: No license. Steady hands.

name: Switchboard
effect: At the start of your turn, if you have fewer cards than your opponent, draw a card.
lore: Every call is a rumor with a destination.

name: Surplus Closet
effect: At the start of your turn, restore 1 Health to your hero.
lore: Bandages older than the war they were packed for.

name: Closer
lore: He ends jobs. He does not start them.
